Gold and silver prices fluctuate amid global economic signals

Gold and silver prices have seen varied movements across India, influenced by global economic factors. Some reports indicate a rise in gold and silver prices, with specific cities like Varanasi showing significant increases, while others note a fall in gold futures and a dip in prices attributed to profit booking. Factors such as weak US jobs data, easing US Federal Reserve rate hike fears, and global trends are cited as drivers for these price changes. Some outlets also mention fluctuations in prices of other commodities like potatoes, onions, and garlic.
